label_cl_label: CD16-positive, CD56-dim natural killer cell, human
label_rationale: The mNK cells are described as CD16+ (FCGR3A), PERFORIN-high, TBET-high, EOMES-intermediate mature NK cells in human adipose tissue, matching the CD16-positive, CD56-dim cytotoxic NK cell phenotype.
marker_cl_label: CD16-positive, CD56-dim natural killer cell, human
marker_rationale: The marker profile shows FCGR3A (CD16), KLRF1 (NKp80), FGFBP2, GNLY, PRF1, GZMB, GZMH, KLRC2 (NKG2C), and cytotoxic effector molecules characteristic of CD56-dim CD16-positive NK cells, with EOMES and T-BET further supporting mature cytotoxic NK cell identity.
title: Single-cell sequencing of human white adipose tissue identifies new cell states in health and obesity

label_rationale: The reported label 'B CELL' directly matches the Cell Ontology term 'B cell' (CL:0000236), and the evidence mentioning IGLL5 and JCHAIN genes supports B cell lineage identity without further subtype specification.
marker_rationale: The marker profile shows IGHA1 (IgA heavy chain), IGLC2/IGLC3 (immunoglobulin light chains), JCHAIN (joining chain critical for IgA secretion), and IGLL5, all characteristic of IgA-secreting plasma cells, consistent with mucosal (colorectal) tissue origin.
title: Molecular Mechanisms of Chinese Medicine in Regulating Colorectal Cancer Immune Microenvironment: Insights from Single-Cell Transcriptomics and Network Pharmacology

label_rationale: The 'IMMUNE-REGULATORY' cluster describes tumor/epithelial cells with an immune-regulatory phenotype (expressing CXCL1/2/3/8, CCL20), not a regulatory immune cell type; none of the candidate terms (which are mostly regulatory T cells or macrophages) match this tumor cell cluster.
marker_rationale: The marker profile (CXCL1, CXCL2, CXCL3, CXCL8, CCL20) represents a pro-inflammatory chemokine signature consistent with tumor cells undergoing epithelial-mesenchymal plasticity in oral squamous cell carcinoma, fitting the malignant cell designation in this cancer scRNAseq context.
title: Mesenchymal-epithelial transition in lymph node metastases of oral squamous cell carcinoma is accompanied by ZEB1 expression

label_rationale: The reported label 'B REGULATORY' with phenotype CD19+CD24highCD38high matches the regulatory B cell (Breg) definition, which is characterized by CD1d-positive expression and immunosuppressive function, and the CD24highCD38high phenotype is a well-established marker combination for human Bregs.
marker_rationale: The markers CD19, CD24, and CD38 on a cell labeled 'B memory' indicate a CD19-positive B cell; however, CD24 and CD38 co-expression can mark transitional or memory B cells, and without CD27 status the specific memory subtype cannot be precisely resolved among the candidates, so the broader CD19-positive B cell term is most appropriate.
title: Multiscale networks in multiple sclerosis

label_rationale: HNDAM (human neurodegenerative disease-associated microglia) is a disease-associated transcriptional state of microglia, and the closest Cell Ontology term is the parent microglial cell type.
marker_rationale: The marker profile includes TREM2, GPNMB, SPP1, LGALS3, APOE, and ABCA1, which are hallmark genes of disease-associated microglia (DAM)/TREM2-positive myeloid cells in neurodegenerative diseases; CL:4047053 (TREM2-positive macrophage) is the closest available candidate term for this microglial/myeloid substate.
title: Integrative analysis reveals generalizable human neurodegenerative disease-associated glial states

label_rationale: The data is from human PBMCs and the marker genes mentioned (HLA-DQA1, HLA-DPA1, HLA-DRB1) are MHC class II genes consistent with HLA-DRA-positive dendritic cells in human, making the human-specific dendritic cell term the best match.
marker_rationale: HLA-DQA1, HLA-DPA1, and HLA-DRB1 are MHC class II genes characteristic of antigen-presenting cells (dendritic cells, monocytes, B cells) within PBMCs; no more specific antigen-presenting cell type is available among candidates, and the data source is explicitly PBMCs.
title: A Variational Inference Approach to Single-Cell Gene Regulatory Network Inference using Probabilistic Matrix Factorization

label_rationale: The reported label 'EXHAUSTED CD8 T CELL' directly matches the synonym 'exhausted CD8 T cell' of CL:0020031, and the context describes PDCD1/TOX expression characteristic of CD8+ T cell exhaustion.
marker_rationale: PDCD1 (PD-1), TOX, and CXCL13 are canonical markers of T cell exhaustion, with TOX being a master transcription factor driving the exhaustion program and CXCL13 marking terminally exhausted T cells.
title: CausalCell: applying causal discovery to single-cell analyses

label_rationale: The study analyzes human developmental haematopoiesis and identifies pDCs expressing IL3RA (CD123), IRF8, and JCHAIN, matching the human-specific pDC term (HLA-DRA+, CD123+, CD11c-, CD14-).
marker_rationale: JCHAIN is a hallmark of plasma/plasmablast cells, while IL3RA, IRF8, and MPEG1 suggest myeloid/dendritic progenitor features; in the context of developmental haematopoiesis this likely represents a progenitor with plasma cell-like transcriptional features, but plasma cell is the closest available candidate.
title: Integrative Single-cell RNA-Seq and ATAC-Seq Analysis of Human Developmental Haematopoiesis

label_rationale: The reported label 'ALVEOLAR MAC' with marker genes MARCO, FABP4, MCEMP1, CD163, APOE, and C1QA/B/C are canonical markers of alveolar macrophages, matching the general alveolar macrophage term rather than any specialized subtype.
marker_rationale: MARCO, FABP4, CD163, APOE, and MCEMP1 are canonical markers of alveolar/tissue-resident macrophages in the lung; the best available candidate is the general macrophage term.
title: Unveiling the influence of tumor and immune signatures on immune checkpoint therapy in advanced lung cancer

label_rationale: The reported label 'NK CELL' with markers XCL1, NCAM1 (CD56), KLRD1, and KLRF1 in CD3-negative cells maps directly to the general natural killer cell term, as no subtype-specific markers (e.g., CD16 status) are provided to justify a more specific classification.
marker_rationale: XCL1, NCAM1 (CD56), KLRD1 (CD94), and KLRF1 (NKp80) are canonical NK cell markers, and the lung cancer context does not support a more specific NK subtype.
title: Unveiling the influence of tumor and immune signatures on immune checkpoint therapy in advanced lung cancer

label_rationale: The evidence describes CD45RO+CD45RA-CD69+ activated memory T cells expressing cytotoxic effector molecules (GZMA, GZMB, IFNG), which are activated memory T cells; the closest available candidate is the broader 'memory T cell' term.
marker_rationale: The marker profile (GZMA, GZMB, IFNG, GZMH, GNLY) strongly indicates a cytotoxic effector lymphocyte with granzyme and perforin/granulysin expression; in the context of anti-CD3/CD28 stimulated PBMCs, this most likely represents activated cytotoxic T cells, and CL:0000910 (cytotoxic T cell, perforin+/granzyme-B+) is the best broad match.
title: Single cell analysis of blood mononuclear cells stimulated through CD3 and CD28 shows collateral activation of B and NK cells and demise of monocytes

label_rationale: The reported label 'NEUTROPHIL' directly matches the Cell Ontology term 'neutrophil' (CL:0000775), and the context describes neutrophils expressing CCR1, CSF2RA, and responding to GM-CSF, consistent with general neutrophil identity without specifying maturation stage.
marker_rationale: The marker profile represents cytokine/chemokine receptor genes (TNFRSF1A/B, IFNAR1/2, CCR1, CSF2RA, IL1R2, IL6R, IL6ST) expressed on paediatric brain tumour cells (medulloblastoma/ATRT) responding to ZIKV infection, consistent with malignant cells expressing immune-related receptors.
title: Multi-omics analysis reveals key immunogenic signatures induced by oncolytic Zika virus infection of paediatric brain tumour cells

label_rationale: The reported label 'MONOCYTE' directly matches the general monocyte term, and the context mentions CD14 and S100A8/S100A9 as hub genes in monocyte CGNs without specifying a particular monocyte subtype.
marker_rationale: S100A8, S100A9, and CD14 are hallmark markers of classical monocytes (CD14+CD16-), which are the predominant monocyte subset expressing high levels of these calprotectin-related genes.
title: HCNetlas: Human cell network atlas enabling cell type-resolved disease genetics

label_rationale: The markers FCN1, S100A8, and S100A9 are characteristic of classical monocytes (CD14+CD16-), which are the predominant monocyte subset and the most likely identity for a broadly labeled 'MONOCYTE' population in scRNA-seq data.
marker_rationale: FCN1, S100A8, and S100A9 are canonical markers of classical (CD14++CD16-) monocytes, with FCN1 being a well-established marker distinguishing classical monocytes from non-classical monocytes.
title: Spatial and Single-Cell Transcriptomics Decipher the Crosstalk Environment of DEFB1+ Cancer Cells and IFI30+ Macrophages in Intrahepatic Cholangiocarcinoma

label_rationale: CD4.9 is described as a transitioning population between naïve and exhausted CD4 T cells expressing both inhibitory (TIGIT, TOX, PDCD1) and naïve/TCM markers (LEF1, CCR7, TCF7, SELL), which does not precisely match any specific subtype but is best captured broadly as a CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell.
marker_rationale: TIGIT, TOX, and PDCD1 (PD-1) are canonical exhaustion markers, while LEF1, CCR7, TCF7, and SELL indicate a progenitor/stem-like exhausted phenotype; the general exhausted T cell term best captures this mixed exhaustion-progenitor signature without committing to CD4 or CD8 lineage.
title: Acquisition of discrete immune suppressive barriers contributes to the initiation and progression of preinvasive to invasive human lung cancer

label_rationale: The CXCL9-positive cluster is explicitly described as macrophages expressing macrophage markers C1QB, CD4, and CD163, with CXCL9 and antigen-presenting gene enrichment; no specific CXCL9+ macrophage subtype exists in the candidates, so the broad 'macrophage' term is most appropriate.
marker_rationale: C1QB, CD163, and CXCL9 are canonical macrophage markers, with CD163 being a hallmark of M2-like/tissue macrophages; CD4 can also be expressed on macrophages, and the combination strongly indicates a macrophage identity in the HNSCC tumor microenvironment.
title: A highly resolved integrated single-cell atlas of HPV-negative head and neck cancer

label_rationale: The CD8T_GZMB subset is described as effector T cells with robust expression of GZMB, GZMA, and PRF1 (perforin), which matches the definition of CD8-positive, alpha-beta cytotoxic T cells characterized by perforin-positive and granzyme B-positive phenotype.
marker_rationale: GZMB, GZMA, and PRF1 are canonical cytotoxic effector molecules (granzymes and perforin) defining cytotoxic function, consistent with the cytotoxic T cell definition of perforin-positive and granzyme-B positive, though these markers could also fit NK cells which are not among candidates.
title: Single-cell transcriptomics reveals immunosuppressive microenvironment and highlights stumor-promoting macrophage cells in Glioblastoma

label_rationale: The reported label 'DCS' refers to dendritic cells as confirmed by the paper's focus on mononuclear phagocytes including DCs, and the evidence describing classical DC genes (HLA-DR, CD1C, CCR7, FLT3, ZBTB46) expressed in cells putatively labeled as DCs from lung and lymph node.
marker_rationale: The marker profile (LAMP3, CCR7, CD40, CD80, HLA-DR, CD1C, IRF4, IRF8, FLT3, ZBTB46) is characteristic of a mature conventional dendritic cell, with LAMP3 and CCR7 being hallmark maturation markers, and ZBTB46/FLT3 confirming cDC lineage.
title: Human and mouse transcriptome profiling identifies cross-species homology in pulmonary and lymph node mononuclear phagocytes
